name: dumbbell deadlift v. 2
description: Lift dumbbells from the floor by hinging at the hips. It strengthens your glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
